title: DCLab Code's sets: sessions as M6 episodes, the person's judgements as M7, choices as M2 and M1 students
request: Continue without stopping, and capture, record and store data for training the six models.
plan: Read the example contracts, the state fields and the tutor before writing a builder
Turn each DCLab Code session on R&D into an episode, judgements and decisions
Register the builder in the conductor; test on a scratch store with the real keeper and shapers

decisions.decision: Reuse the ledger's declared state fields (step, move, kind, method, gate_required, concern_source, rounds)
decisions.why: a new field would change a frozen dclab_core contract; these hold bands and codes only

decisions.decision: M6 weight silver, M7 M2 M1 gold
decisions.why: the steps are Claude's (silver by the owner's rule); the person's choices are gold

decisions.decision: A tool's output never enters a set
decisions.why: it may hold a table's rows

decisions.decision: Points dclab_code.permission and dclab_code.plan_approval in M1
decisions.why: a little student per small choice, fitted by the tutor where rows reach the bar

change: dclab_rnd/store/sets/dclab_code.py (new), conductor builders step, keeper feeds, tutor's above_rule, tests/test_store_dclab_code_sets.py, STORING_PHASE_PLAN 32.34.

findings.defect: a session's split differed from its Claude Code transcript's
findings.scenario: session a8ce6cbc: the transcript sealed, this builder train; 1,152 of 2,000 random ids split apart
findings.cause: split_of('session:'+id) against the shaper's split_of(raw id)
findings.fix: split_of(the raw SDK session id), the transcript's own key
findings.impact: the same session's thinking in the sealed M5 set and its steps in M6 and M7 train

findings.defect: lines read out of order, so the person's decisions were lost
findings.scenario: a tool use at 10:59:58 and its deny at 11:00:05: the step came out auto_no_result and the deny was in no set
findings.cause: the shaper rewrites id-shaped strings, the lines' timestamps included, and the builder sorted by them
findings.fix: file order from the record id's line number; joins by tool use and request ids in two passes

findings.defect: the app's own denies were stored as the person's gold labels
findings.scenario: Stop while a Read waits: M2 and M1 got deny with label_source person, M7 a score 0 by the person
findings.cause: denyAll and the abort handler record decisions nobody made
findings.fix: decisions by the app (by: app in new records; the three automatic texts or a decision after a stop in old ones) never enter a set; the step's outcome is cancelled

findings.defect: a grade was paired with the wrong answer
findings.scenario: turn 1 answered A and was graded good; turn 2 was stopped and graded bad; M7 got A with score 0
findings.cause: the last answer was not reset after a turn's result
findings.fix: reset after each result; match a grade by its turn number (recorded by the app from now on)

findings.defect: the tutor said a student beat a rule that does not exist
findings.scenario: a point with no rule scores the rule 0, so any student is above_rule
findings.cause: above_rule compared accuracies without asking whether the rule answered
findings.fix: above_rule only when the rule answered; rule_answered in the measurement

findings.defect: a stopped turn ended as error_during_execution
findings.scenario: after Stop the SDK still sends a result
findings.fix: a turn with a stop ends as stopped

measurements.name: store tests
measurements.gate: every store test passes, the new edge cases included
measurements.result: test_store_dclab_code_sets 3, test_store_dclab_code 5, tutor, sets_others, conductor, shapers: all passed

outcome: DCLab Code's sessions on R&D become M6 episodes and the person's gold choices M7, M2 and M1 examples, in the transcript's split.
lessons: Never order or join on a field a shaper may rewrite: use ids and file order
A builder's split key must be the very key the shaper gives the same session elsewhere
An automatic decision recorded beside a person's must say who made it
risks: a command or a DCLab tool argument in a judged step could hold a value
few rows per point until the owner uses the app
